description.value: The Executive Plaza Hotel is a 140-room boutique luxury hotel in Coquitlam, consistently ranked as a top TripAdvisor property and certified as a 3 Green Key Global sustainability partner. It offers contemporary rooms with floor-to-ceiling windows, an on-site restaurant and bar (The Wild Fig) with room service, and a rooftop pool deck with hot tub, steam room, and tennis court. Situated near Lougheed Mall, Highway 1, and public transit, it serves both business and leisure travellers in the Burnaby/Coquitlam/New Westminster corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website loaded successfully and provides detailed amenity information across multiple subpages. Laundry/dry-cleaning service and high-speed Wi-Fi are explicitly listed on the amenities page; The Wild Fig Restaurant & Bar in the hotel lobby confirms on-site evening food. No mention of bike storage, bike-specific procedures, or any cycling amenities appears anywhere on the site, so those remain null. Phone number and address on the contact page match OSM exactly.
concerns: Footer on the contact page reads 'Privacy and Cookie Policy | The Executive Suites Hotel', a slightly different brand name than 'Executive Plaza Hotel' — likely the same management group but worth noting.
Booking widget throughout the site shows static placeholder dates of July 2023, suggesting the site content may not be frequently refreshed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active 140-room hotel with a fully operational website, confirmed contact details, and on-site dining; a real, publicly accessible accommodation useful to touring cyclists.

Laundry.detail: Laundry / Dry-cleaning service explicitly listed on the amenities page

Nearby evening food.detail: The Wild Fig Restaurant & Bar is located in the hotel lobby; room service also available during operation hours

wow_evidence: rooftop pool deck with hot tub, steam room, and tennis court
